theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 2 群

items.colloc: in this regard 在這方面 | with regard to 關於
items.distinct: in this respect 在這方面 | as for... 至於...
ex: We have no information in this regard.
我們關於這一點沒有任何資訊。
Please advise us in this regard immediately.
請就此事盡快給予我們建議。
No further action is needed in this regard.
關於這一點無需採取進一步行動。

items.colloc: find out the truth 找出真相 | find out information 查明資訊
items.distinct: discover 發現（本來就存在） | figure out 理解；想出解決方法
ex: I will find out when the flight arrives.
我會查明班機抵達的時間。
She wants to find out about our policy.
她想了解我們公司的政策。
Management needs to find out the cause of delay.
管理層需要查明延誤的原因。

items.colloc: clean up the office 清理辦公室 | clean up the mess 清理混亂
items.distinct: clear up 解釋清楚；消除誤會 | tidy up 收拾；整理
ex: Everyone should help to clean up the pantry.
每個人都應該幫忙清理茶水間。
We need to clean up the data before analysis.
分析前我們需要先整頓資料。
Staff members were asked to clean up their desks.
員工被要求清理各自的辦公桌。

items.zh: 頭等艙；一流的；最優質的
items.colloc: first class service 一流的服務 | first class ticket 頭等艙票
items.distinct: top-notch 頂尖的 | premium 高級的
ex: She booked a first class seat for the flight.
她預訂了飛行旅程的頭等艙座位。
The hotel is known for its first class service.
這家飯店以其一流的服務聞名。
We provide first class support to our clients.
我們提供客戶一流的支援服務。

items.colloc: do something right away 立刻做某事 | need it right away 急需
items.distinct: at once 立即 | immediately 立即
ex: Please process the order right away.
請立刻處理這份訂單。
I will send the report to you right away.
我會馬上把報告寄給你。
The manager wants to see you right away.
經理想要立刻見你。

items.colloc: apply for a job 應徵工作 | apply for a position 申請職位
items.distinct: apply to 應用於；向...申請 | request 要求
ex: She decided to apply for the marketing position.
她決定申請行銷職位。
You must apply for the visa before traveling.
旅行前你必須申請簽證。
Many candidates applied for the internship program.
許多候選人申請了實習計畫。

items.colloc: attend an award ceremony 參加頒獎典禮 | hold an award ceremony 舉辦頒獎典禮
items.distinct: opening ceremony 開幕典禮 | closing ceremony 閉幕典禮
ex: The award ceremony will start at two o'clock.
頒獎典禮將於兩點開始。
Please confirm your attendance at the award ceremony.
請確認是否出席頒獎典禮。
The CEO will speak at the annual award ceremony.
執行長將在年度頒獎典禮上致詞。

items.zh: 被建議做某事；宜做某事
items.colloc: be advised to arrive early 建議提早到達 | be advised to contact us 建議聯絡我們
items.distinct: be suggested that 建議（子句） | be recommended 被推薦
ex: Employees are advised to lock their computers.
建議員工將電腦鎖定。
You are advised to review the contract carefully.
建議您仔細審閱這份合約。
Visitors are advised to bring a valid ID.
建議訪客攜帶有效身分證件。

items.colloc: be aware of the risks 意識到風險 | be aware of the deadline 知道截止日期
items.distinct: be conscious of 有自覺的 | be familiar with 熟悉
ex: Are you aware of the new safety regulations?
你知道新的安全規定嗎？
The manager is fully aware of the situation.
經理完全了解目前的狀況。
Please be aware of the limited parking space.
請留意有限的停車空間。

items.colloc: be likely to succeed 很可能會成功 | be likely to change 很可能變動
items.distinct: be expected to 被預期會 | be prone to 易於（負面）
ex: Sales are likely to increase this quarter.
這季的銷售額很可能會成長。
The project is likely to be finished soon.
這個專案很可能很快會完成。
We are likely to reach our target by Friday.
我們很可能在週五前達成目標。

items.colloc: at the bus stop 在公車站 | near the bus stop 在公車站附近
items.distinct: bus station 客運轉運站 | subway station 地鐵站
ex: The bus stop is located across the street.
公車站就在街的對面。
We will meet you at the bus stop.
我們會在公車站與你會合。
Is there a bus stop near the hotel?
飯店附近有公車站嗎？

items.colloc: have a business talk 進行商務會談 | start a business talk 開始洽談業務
items.distinct: business meeting 商務會議 | business negotiation 商務談判
ex: We had a productive business talk this morning.
我們今天早上進行了一場很有成效的商務會談。
He is engaged in a business talk with partners.
他正在與合作夥伴進行商務會談。
They scheduled a business talk for next Tuesday.
他們將商務會談安排在下週二。

items.zh: 繁忙的街道；熱鬧的街道
items.colloc: on a busy street 在繁忙的街道上 | a busy street corner 繁忙的街角
items.distinct: crowded area 擁擠區域 | heavy traffic 交通繁忙
ex: The office is located on a busy street.
辦公室位於一條繁忙的街道上。
Parking is difficult on this busy street.
在這條繁忙的街道上停車很困難。
Many shops are opening on that busy street.
那條繁忙的街道上開了許多店鋪。

items.colloc: contact by telephone 以電話聯繫 | order by telephone 以電話訂購
items.distinct: over the phone 在電話中 | on the telephone 在講電話
ex: Please confirm the details by telephone.
請透過電話確認細節。
We can discuss the contract by telephone.
我們可以透過電話討論合約。
You may register for the seminar by telephone.
您可以透過電話報名研討會。

items.pos: n. 總公司；中心辦公室
items.colloc: report to the central office 向總公司報告 | contact the central office 聯繫總部
items.distinct: headquarters 總部 | branch office 分公司
ex: Documents must be sent to the central office.
文件必須送到總公司。
The central office is based in Taipei.
總公司設於台北。
I will check with the central office first.
我會先跟總公司確認。

items.colloc: order cleaning supplies 訂購清潔用品 | store cleaning supplies 存放清潔用品
items.distinct: office supplies 辦公用品 | maintenance tools 維修工具
ex: We are running low on cleaning supplies.
我們的清潔用品快用完了。
Please store the cleaning supplies in the closet.
請將清潔用品存放在壁櫥裡。
The cleaning supplies are provided by the company.
清潔用品由公司提供。

items.colloc: use the copy machine 使用影印機 | fix the copy machine 修理影印機
items.distinct: printer 印表機 | scanner 掃描器
ex: The copy machine is out of paper again.
影印機又沒紙了。
Please do not leave your documents on the copy machine.
請不要把文件留在影印機上。
We need to repair the office copy machine.
我們需要修理辦公室的影印機。

items.colloc: work at a department store 在百貨公司工作 | shop at a department store 在百貨公司購物
items.distinct: supermarket 超級市場 | mall 購物中心
ex: They are opening a new branch in the department store.
他們正在百貨公司裡開設一家新分店。
The department store holds a sale every summer.
百貨公司每年夏天都會舉辦特賣會。
She bought a new suit at the department store.
她在百貨公司買了一套新西裝。

items.colloc: meet the due date 準時完成 | extend the due date 延長截止日期
items.distinct: deadline 最後期限 | expiration date 到期日
ex: The due date for the report is Friday.
報告的截止日期是週五。
Please submit your project before the due date.
請在截止日期前提交您的專案。
We have to change the due date for payment.
我們必須更改付款的截止日期。

items.colloc: consume energy drinks 飲用能量飲料 | sell energy drinks 販售能量飲料
items.distinct: soft drink 軟性飲料 | sports drink 運動飲料
ex: Many employees drink energy drinks during overtime.
許多員工在加班時會喝能量飲料。
The new energy drink has become very popular.
這款新款能量飲料變得很熱門。
He avoids drinking energy drinks late at night.
他避免在深夜飲用能量飲料。
